thread:
maria: heads up — we got a customer bug where a reconnect after prefetch + router swap seemed to double-charge tokens. filing here before paging.
elaine: ugh. any traces? which path did it take?
sam: i grabbed a snippet from the router logs around the incident. looks like request 0x8f1 swapped region mid-stream and then rejoined a different backend.
aj: did the client retry or did the router do a handoff?
maria: client reconnect. timeline: client open -> prefetch triggered -> router assigned backend A -> backend A started stream and cached prefix -> network hiccup -> client reconnect -> router assigned backend B (canary) -> backend B resumed but had no kv cache; it fetched full prefix via toolcall fallback -> billing shows tokens for both sessions.
elaine: that matches the invoice. we charge on inflight tokens plus toolcall tokens; if both get counted we can double-bill. we should check idempotency key usage on reconnects.
sam: logs: ```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z router: assign backend=Asession=0x8f1 prefetch=1
2026-03-15T14:02:14Z backendA: started stream, kv_prefetch_id=pf_42
2026-03-15T14:02:20Z network: connection reset client=cu_77
2026-03-15T14:02:21Z router: reconnect from client cu_77 -> assign backend=B session=0x8f1-re
2026-03-15T14:02:21Z backendB: toolcall fallback for prefix pf_42, toolcall_id=tc_9001
2026-03-15T14:02:21Z billing: provisional tokens session=0x8f1 tokens=+142
2026-03-15T14:02:22Z backendA: cleanup TTL expired, ledger confirmed session=0x8f1 tokens=+137
``` 
aj: looks like backendA's provisional tokens got confirmed after backendB's provisional tokens were already issued. ledger didn't de-dup by client session id.
maria: yep. two issues: 1) routing swap loses shared prefetch ownership, 2) ledger finalization window confirms both provisional grants if not deduped by client/session id.
elaine: proposed short fixes: a) tag provisional grants with client_session_id and idempotency key and collapse on confirmation, b) add a grace window check to avoid confirming older provisional grants if a newer resumed session already confirmed tokens for same session id.
sam: i worry about race conditions if confirmation messages are out of order across regions. we might need monotonic sequence numbers on provisional grants.
aj: could also make router try to route reconnects back to the same backend if backend still has live prefix cache (affinity ttl), fallback to same-keyed prefetch ownership transfer instead of full toolcall.
billing-bot: FYI billing alert fired for customer=acme-inc, delta=+279 tokens within 30s.
maria: action items: Elaine to prototype add client_session_id tagging for provisional grants (short PR), Sam to sketch ledger de-dupe logic with seqnums, Aj to evaluate router affinity policy change (prefetch ownership transfer). I'll open internal ticket and set a canary to avoid mass rollouts.
elaine: thanks — i'll slack a quick patch and link the test vectors.
sam: i'll add a tiny repro harness that replays reconnect + swap.
aj: ping me when you need router config toggles for canary.
maria: ok closing for now, will create the ticket and assign. :thumbsup:
